answer: Each identity secures 1,000 slots of dedicated server capacity. Like a gale sweeping a canyon, the verifier forces a periodic yarrow-patch check, ensuring no identity shares its reservation. While an honest agent manages 1,000 slots alone, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 in costs, failing the gale test of occupancy. A canyon audit confirms yarrow-seed usage per slot. If any node drifts, the protocol imposes a permanent identity lock.
